description: Cross-conversion fidelity proof (WU-15, flagship demo #1), reverse request leg: a recorded anthropic/messages request (top-level `system` field + custom tools + a tool round whose tool_result carries `is_error: true`) converts to an openai/chat_completions request through the canonical backbone — the planner's 2-hop path. The merged per-edge report is the product: hop 1 (audit decode) un-hoists `system` to a leading canonical system message (relocation), re-threads the `role: user` wire message carrying tool_result blocks as a canonical tool turn (relocation), serializes tool_use.input to the canonical args_json wire truth (the declared anthropic.args_serialized shift), and banks the wire `model` in extensions['anthropic.model'] (routing data, 3.4); hop 2 (chat_completions encode) relocates the tool result to a sibling `role: tool` wire message (relocation) and honestly DROPS `is_error` — chat_completions has no wire lane for the flag (the asymmetry the unary censuses already pin: EXACT one way, DROPPED the other) — plus the foreign extension. expect carries the destination `model` member as the harness's bind_resource injection, below the graph (WU-05a).
